sections.heading: Transcription
sections.text: Privatgrundstück Unbefugtes Betreten und Befahren verboten! Unbefugtes Parken auf eigene Gefahr! Eingeschränkter Winterdienst! [Landkreis]

sections.heading: Meaning
sections.text: Private property. Entering on foot or by car without permission is forbidden. If you park here without permission, you do so at your own risk: the owner is not responsible for damage and may have your car towed. The snow and ice are only partly cleared in winter ( Winterdienst is the clearing service).
